methodology.measurementDifferentialTests: The pinned original measurement source is compiled only into the test target. Symbol names are changed to avoid collisions; scripts/test/generate_measurement_baseline.py --check verifies provenance.
methodology.dependencyScope: Original and migrated implementations run with the current SDK and dependencies. This is not a comparison of historical app binaries or historical operating systems.
methodology.otherContracts: Assertions are derived from source behavior and user-facing expectations. Tests use real UIKit views and native dialogs, isolated persistence, and deterministic transport/cloud doubles.
methodology.dialogScope: AlertActionRecorder invokes the same handler passed to native UIAlertAction. Tests cover callback behavior and real dialog construction; they do not simulate UIKit touch recognition or automatic dismissal. DiscoveryDialogContractTests also intercepts presentation to inspect the constructed native dialog without requiring an app-hosted module test.
methodology.coverageScope: All first-party production executable lines compiled in the Debug simulator build remain in the denominator. Generated baseline code belongs only to the test target. Hardware and defensive paths are not excluded to increase the percentage. Release-only conditional paths are separately build-checked; the reported percentage is not Release coverage.

intentionalCorrections.change: Explicit humidity units use their own configured precision; formatting without settings avoids forced trailing decimals.
intentionalCorrections.status: Previously implemented; differential test documents the deviation.

intentionalCorrections.change: Apply the existing firmware safe-dismiss guard to the NFC upgrade route.
Ignore callbacks from stopped or superseded observations and deliver transport state callbacks on the main thread.

Ignore duplicate discoveries and obsolete callbacks, cancel the scan deadline after discovery, and close an outstanding transport when the client is released. Detach operation state before transport cleanup.
Integer-formatting paths return the existing unavailable marker instead of trapping on NaN, infinity or out-of-range values. Valid-value rounding remains unchanged.
intentionalCorrections.evidence: expanded-air-red.xcresult includes the reproduced non-finite integer conversion crash.

intentionalCorrections.change: Both settings layouts reject minute values that overflow conversion to seconds, including values arriving before an editing-change event. Ordinary minute values and confirmation behavior are preserved.
Use UIKit UTF-16 offsets and lay out text before scrolling to the latest entry, so emoji names do not leave the newest text offscreen.
Starting observation first detaches previous observers, preventing duplicate notifications and callbacks after stop.
Validate NSRange using UTF-16 length and subtraction-based bounds checks, preserving valid replacements and rejecting negative or overflowing ranges without trapping.

limits: CoreBluetooth radio operations and real sensor acknowledgements require physical hardware.
Firmware transfer, NFC hardware, APNs delivery, remote cloud availability and system permission prompts need integration validation outside deterministic simulator tests.
Tested workflows and differential checks provide evidence for their inputs; line coverage alone cannot prove complete behavioral equivalence.
